title: Mini Boxing Final Round
seo_title: Mini Boxing Final Round — Play Free Boxing Game Online
meta_desc: Play Mini Boxing Final Round free online. Jab, straight and uppercut your way past six fighters to win the mini boxing world championship.
desc: Mini Boxing Final Round is a retro-style boxing campaign. Fight as Nick Joe, mix jabs, straights and uppercuts, guard and dodge, and beat six opponents to take the world championship.
howto: Press Z for a jab and X for a straight.
Press C for the super uppercut.
Hold Up or W to guard, Down or S to dodge.
Move with Left and Right arrows.
Tap Space fast to get up after a knockdown.
tips: Jab first — it opens the guard for the straight.
Dodge the opponent's power punch, then counter with the uppercut.
Never uppercut into a guarding opponent.
